event_object_killed_object.doc: Event for when the specified object kills an object/component (object = killer, param = killed object/component, param2 = kill method)

event_object_known_to_player.doc: Event for when an object becomes known to the player (object = object that is becoming known to the player)

event_object_launched_countermeasure.doc: Event for an object launching a countermeasure (object = the launching defensible, param = launched countermeasure)

event_object_launched_distressdrone.doc: Event for an object launching a distress drone (object = the launching defensible, param = launched distress drone)

event_object_launched_lasertower.doc: Event for an object launching a lasertower (object = the launching defensible, param = launched lasertower)

event_object_launched_mine.doc: Event for an object launching a mine (object = the launching defensible, param = launched mine)

event_object_launched_missile.doc: Event for the specified object launching a missile (object = missile launching object, param = target component, param2 = missile)

event_object_launched_navbeacon.doc: Event for an object launching a navigation beacon (object = the launching defensible, param = launched navigation beacon)

event_object_launched_resourceprobe.doc: Event for an object launching a resourceprobe (object = the launching defensible, param = launched resourceprobe)

event_object_launched_satellite.doc: Event for an object launching a satellite (object = the launching defensible, param = launched satellite)

event_object_left.doc: Event on an object or a space, e.g. zone, for when any object leaves it or is removed (object = left space/container, param = leaving object, param2 = new context of leaving object, param3 = old context of leaving object).

group.doc: Group of event objects (can be supplied instead of a single event object). The check attribute does not apply. The group is required to exist but may be empty. Adding/removing group members is possible even after the event is set up.

space.doc: Space which is left (i.e. zone, sector or cluster), or direct container context which is left (ship or station)

event_object_left_live_view.doc: Event for when the object is no longer visible on the gravidar of any player-owned object (object = leaving object)

event_object_miningdronemode_changed.doc: Event for the specified object changing drone modes for its mining drones (object = object that launches drones, param = new drone mode)

event_object_miningdrones_armed.doc: Event for the specified object authorizing mining drone use (object = object that launches drones)

event_object_miningdrones_disarmed.doc: Event for the specified object unauthorizing mining drone use (object = object that launches drones)

event_object_money_updated.doc: Event for when the objects' money gets updated (object = container of the account, param = oldamount, param2 = newamount)

event_object_moved_into_internal_storage.doc: Event for the specified object having been moved into internal storage (object = stored object, param = old docking bay, param2 = internal docking bay)

event_object_opened_lockbox.doc: Event for when an object has opened a lockbox (object = object opening the lockbox, param = lockbox which was opened)

event_object_order_cancelled.doc: Event for when the a running AI order is cancelled (object = the order's owner object, param = order, param2 = true iff the order is not in the critical state and is cancelled immediately). NOTE: If param2 is true then the order (event.param) was already cancelled and was either reset or does not exist any more.

immediate.doc: Is the order cancelled immediately? This is true except for orders in the critical state. Orders in the critical state can handle cancel requests by listening to this event with immediate="false".

event_object_order_finished.doc: Event for when the running AI order is finished (object = the order's owner object, param = order). Note that it is possible that the order no longer exists.

event_object_order_param_edited.doc: Event for when a parameter of a running AI order in the critical state is edited (object = the order's owner object, param = order, param2 = order param name, param3 = order param value)

name.doc: Order param name string

event_object_order_ready.doc: Event for when an AI order in an object's order queue gets enabled (entering the ready state), when the default order gets enabled, or when there is an order in the queue that should be started (either current or next order), even if it was already enabled before (object = the object receiving the order, param = order)

event_object_order_syncpoint_released.doc: Event for when the sync point of an infinite AI order in an object's order queue gets released, indicating that the order should finish (object = the order's owner object, param = order)

event_object_phase_started.doc: Event for when an animation phase has started (object = object that the phase started on, param = phase string)

event_object_picked_up.doc: Event for when the specified object is picked up by another object (object = pickup, param = collector)

event_object_picked_up_object.doc: Event for when the specified object picks up another object (object = collector, param = pickup)

event_object_processingmodule_available.doc: Event for when a processing module is ready to accept new material (object = station the processing module belongs to, param = processing module)

event_object_production_cancelled.doc: Event for when an object has cancelled its production queue (object = container or productionmodule, param = productionmodule, param2 = whether a research project was cancelled, param3 = list of cancelled product wares)

event_object_production_finished.doc: Event for when an object has finished production of a ware (object = container or productionmodule, param = productionmodule, param2 = product ware, param3 = whether this was a research project) (see also event_object_production_started)

event_object_production_started.doc: Event for when an object has started production of a ware (object = container or productionmodule, param = productionmodule, param2 = product ware, param3 = whether this is a research project) (see also event_object_production_finished)

event_object_props_despawning.doc: Event for when an object has props about to be despawned (object = the populated component or its container, param = component which was populated)

event_object_props_generated.doc: Event for when an object has had props generated (object = the populated component or its container, param = component which was populated)

event_object_relation_range_changed.doc: Event for the specified object changing relation range (object = the object changing relation, param = faction with which relation has changed)

event_object_removed_from_formation.doc: Event for the specified object having been removed from a formation (object = removed object)

event_object_retrieved_from_internal_sto.doc: Event for the specified object having been retrieved from internal storage (object = retrieved object, param = new docking bay, param2 = internal docking bay)

event_object_salvage_claim_lost.doc: Event for when an object has lost its salvage claim on an object (either for dismantling or towing). (object = object performing the salvaging, param = the claimed object, param2 = the successful claiming object if any)

event_object_salvage_claim_successful.doc: Event for when an object has been claimed successfully for salvage (either for dismantling or towing). (object = the claimed object, param = the successful claiming object)

event_object_shield_damaged.doc: Event for the specified object's shield being damaged (object = event source, param = damaged component, param2 = new shield value, param3 = damage)

event_object_signalled.doc: Event for the specified object being signalled (object = signalled object, param = custom, usually to specify type of signal, param2 = custom, param3 = custom)

event_object_stance_activated.doc: Event for when an object has activated a stance (object = object activating the stance, param = stance ID)

stance.doc: Stance ID from libraries/stances.xml. Also needs to be in the ship macro's list of supported stances.

event_object_started_to_dock_at.doc: Event for an object starting to dock at the specified container (object = container object, param = docking object, param2 = new context, param3 = old context)

check.doc: Produce an error message if the provided event object does not exist? Default is true. NOTE: If the event object is a variable or a changeable property, changing it at a later time has no direct effect on this event condition, i.e. it is not re-enabled automatically. It is only updated under certain conditions, e.g. when loading a savegame or when the event condition is restarted explicitly (resetting MD cue or starting AI script).

container.doc: Container object (station or ship, required if group attribute not supplied)

group.doc: Group of event objects (can be supplied instead of a single event object). The check attribute does not apply. The group is required to exist but may be empty. Adding/removing group members is possible even after the event is set up.

event_object_started_to_undock_from.doc: Event for an object starting to undock from the specified container (object = container object, param = undocking object, param2 = new context, param3 = old context)

check.doc: Produce an error message if the provided event object does not exist? Default is true. NOTE: If the event object is a variable or a changeable property, changing it at a later time has no direct effect on this event condition, i.e. it is not re-enabled automatically. It is only updated under certain conditions, e.g. when loading a savegame or when the event condition is restarted explicitly (resetting MD cue or starting AI script).

container.doc: Container object (station or ship, required if group attribute not supplied)

group.doc: Group of event objects (can be supplied instead of a single event object). The check attribute does not apply. The group is required to exist but may be empty. Adding/removing group members is possible even after the event is set up.

event_object_subordinate_added.doc: Event for when a new subordinate is added to a commander (object = new commander, param = subordinate, param2 = new assignment)

event_object_subordinate_promoted.doc: Event for when a new subordinate is promoted in place of the old commander (object = old commander, param = promoted subordinate)

event_object_subordinate_removed.doc: Event for when a subordinate is removed from a commander (object = old commander, param = subordinate, param2 = old commander)

event_object_target_invalid.doc: Event for when an object's target is invalid, e.g. went through a jump gate, does not exist any more etc. (object = object with an invalid target, param = invalid target, param2 = true iff the target is actually not reachable)

event_object_took_area_damage.doc: Event for when an object has taken area damage (object = damaged object, param = damage source)

event_object_towed_recyclable_near_furna.doc: Event for when a recyclable object is near a furnace that can process it (object = tug ship, param = processing module, param2 = recyclable object)

event_object_transportdronemode_changed.doc: Event for the specified object changing drone modes for its transport drones (object = object where drones are based, param = new drone mode)

event_object_transportdrones_armed.doc: Event for the specified object authorizing transport drone use (object = object that launches drones)

event_object_transportdrones_disarmed.doc: Event for the specified object unauthorizing transport drone use (object = object that launches drones)

event_object_triggered.doc: Event for when an object is triggered (object = trigger object, param = triggerer)

event_object_undocked.doc: Event for the specified object undocking (object = undocking object, param = dock, param2 = zone, param3 = docking bay)

event_object_undocked_from.doc: Event for an object undocking from the specified container (object = container object, param = undocking object, param2 = new context, param3 = old context)

check.doc: Produce an error message if the provided event object does not exist? Default is true. NOTE: If the event object is a variable or a changeable property, changing it at a later time has no direct effect on this event condition, i.e. it is not re-enabled automatically. It is only updated under certain conditions, e.g. when loading a savegame or when the event condition is restarted explicitly (resetting MD cue or starting AI script).

container.doc: Container object (station or ship, required if group attribute not supplied)

group.doc: Group of event objects (can be supplied instead of a single event object). The check attribute does not apply. The group is required to exist but may be empty. Adding/removing group members is possible even after the event is set up.

event_object_undocking_cleared.doc: Event for the specified object being cleared to undock (object = docked object)

event_object_undocking_started.doc: Event for the specified object starting to undock (object = undocking object, param = dock, param2 = zone, param3 = docking bay)

event_object_weapon_ammo_changed.doc: Event for when a weapon on an object has changed its ammo (object = object with weapon, param = weapon, param2 = new ammo macro, can be null)

event_object_weaponmode_changed.doc: Event for the specified object changing a weapon mode (object = object changing the weapon mode, param = weapon, param2 = new weapon mode)

weapon.doc: Weapon for which the mode will be changed (optional)

weaponmode.doc: New weapon mode in which the weapon will be changed (optional)

event_observation_started.doc: Event for when an object starts an observation (requires attribute observer and/or observed) (object = observer or observed, param = observer, param2 = observed, param3 = range length)

observed.doc: Object which is observed, or group of objects (attribute must be present if observer not supplied)

observer.doc: Object which performs the observation, or group of objects (attribute must be present if observed not supplied)

event_observation_stopped.doc: Event for when an observation is stopped (requires attribute observer and/or observed) (object = observer or observed, param = observer, param2 = observed)

observed.doc: Object which is observed, or group of objects (attribute must be present if observer not supplied)

observer.doc: Object which performs the observation, or group of objects (attribute must be present if observed not supplied)

event_offer_accepted.doc: Event for when a cue offer is accepted (object = cue)

event_online_offer_outdated.doc: Event for when an online mission offer is outdated (object = offer cue)

event_online_offer_requested.doc: Event for when the creation of an online mission offer is requested (param = online mission ID string)

event_phase_started.doc: Event for when an animation phase has started (param = phase string, param2 = object that the phase started on)

event_platform_actor_created.doc: Event for when a character is created on a platform by platform population system, or manually by <create_platform_actor> (param = actor, param2 = entity type, param3 = true iff actor is a representative)

event_player_activated_cockpit_view.doc: Event for the player setting the camera to cockpit view (also triggered if the camera was already in this view)

event_player_activated_external_target_v.doc: Event for the player setting the camera to external target view (also triggered if the camera was already in this view)

event_player_activated_external_view.doc: Event for the player setting the camera to external view (also triggered if the camera was already in this view)

event_player_activated_floating_view.doc: Event for the player setting the camera to floating view (also triggered if the camera was already in this view)

event_player_activated_platform_trigger.doc: Event is raised when the player has manually activated a platform trigger (e.g. a button or panel) (param = trigger component, param2 = trigger group tag)

event_player_activated_weapon.doc: Event for when the player ship activates a weapon (param = Weapon, param2 = ammo type (null if unlimited), param3 = ammo amount (not set if unlimited))

amount.doc: Ammo amount

event_player_activated_weapongroup.doc: Event for when the player ship activates a weapon group (param = weapongroup index, param2 = true for primary, false for secondary group)

event_player_alert.doc: Event for when a player alert is triggered (object = location (sector), param = alert message, param2 = sound id, param3 = object list)

location.doc: Location (sector) in which the alert was raised

event_player_assigned_hired_actor.doc: Event for when the player assigns an actor (entity or template) to a control post or a role (param = actor (entity or list containing context and template), param2 = target object, param3 = post or role). NOTE: The actual assignment happens as a result of this event.

actor.doc: Actor entity (NPC) or list containing context and NPC template

event_player_attacked_object.doc: Event for when the player attacks an object from their currently controlled object (param = attacked object, param2 = kill method, param3 = [attacked component, weapon])

event_player_blueprint_added.doc: Event is raised when the player has unlocked a blueprint (param = blueprint's module macro, param2 = blueprint's ware)

event_player_bomb_attached.doc: Event is raised when the player or a player-owned object has successfully attached a bomb (param = bomb that was attached)

event_player_bomb_defused.doc: Event is raised when the player has successfully defused a bomb (param = bomb that was defused)

event_player_boost_charging_aborted.doc: Event for when the player aborts charging boost

event_player_boost_charging_started.doc: Event for when the player starts charging boost

event_player_boost_started.doc: Event for when the player starts boosting

event_player_boost_stopped.doc: Event for when the player stops boosting

event_player_build_added.doc: Event for when a build task for the player is added to a container (param = buildtask, param2 = building container)

event_player_build_cancelled.doc: Event for when a player-owned build is cancelled (param = buildtask)

event_player_build_finished.doc: Event for when a player-owned build finishes (param = buildprocessor, param2 = unused, param3 = buildtask)

event_player_build_finished_components.doc: Event for when a player-owned build partially finishes. List of completed components is provided. (param = buildprocessor, param2 = list of completed components, param3 = buildtask)

event_player_build_loadout_applied.doc: Event for when a player-owned build has applied a loadout to the build component. List of added components is provided. (param = buildprocessor, param2 = new components, param3 = buildtask)

event_player_build_plot_changed.doc: Event for when a player-owned station's build plot is resized or repositioned (param = station, param2 = old build plot max, param3 = old build plot center)

station.doc: Station for which build plot changed

event_player_build_started.doc: Event for when a player-owned build starts (param = buildprocessor, param2 = unused, param3 = buildtask)

vDoc.8.00: Event for when a player-owned build starts (param = buildprocessor, param2 = constructionsequence, param3 = buildtask)

event_player_built_ship.doc: Event for when a player-owned ship is constructed to operational state (param = ship, param2 = buildtask)

event_player_built_station.doc: Event for when a player-owned station is constructed to operational state (param = station, param2 = buildtask)

event_player_changed_activity.doc: Event for when the player changes activity (param = new activity, param2 = old activity)

event_player_changed_target.doc: Event for when the player changes target (param = new target. null if player deselects target.)

event_player_collect_ware_failed.doc: Event for when the player unsuccessfully attempts to collect a ware drop on collision (param = ware, param2 = amount, param3 = crate object that cannot be collected)

amount.doc: Ware amount

crate.doc: The crate object that cannot be collected

event_player_collected_ammo.doc: Event for when the player collects ammo (param = weapon macro, param2 = amount)

amount.doc: Ammo amount

event_player_collected_blueprint.doc: Event for when the player collects a blueprint drop (param = ware)

event_player_collected_data.doc: Event for when the player collects data (timeline or audiolog) from a drop or crate (param = type, param2 = id)

event_player_collected_powerup.doc: Event for when the player collects a powerup

event_player_collected_ware.doc: Event for when the player collects a ware drop (param = ware, param2 = amount, param3 = collected object)

amount.doc: Ware amount

event_player_commission_added.doc: Event for when a commission for the player is added (object = source object or source faction, param = display name, param2 = commission amount, param3 = end time)

source.doc: Source of discount/commission, can be an object or a faction

event_player_crafted_ammo.doc: Event for when the player crafts ammo from inventory wares (param = weapon macro, param2 = amount)

amount.doc: Ammo amount

event_player_created.doc: Event for when the player is created (no parameters)

event_player_created_signal_leaks.doc: Event is raised when the player has created signal leaks (param = list of signal leaks)

event_player_cycled_active_weapon_ammo.doc: Event for the player cycling the ammunition of active weapons

event_player_deactivated_platform_trigge.doc: Event is raised when the player has manually deactivated a platform trigger (e.g. a button or panel) (param = trigger component, param2 = trigger group tag)

event_player_deactivated_weapon.doc: Event for when the player ship deactivates a weapon (param = Weapon)

event_player_deactivated_weapongroup.doc: Event for when the player ship deactivates a weapon group (param = weapongroup index, param2 = true for primary, false for secondary group)

event_player_detected_object.doc: Event for when an object is detected by the player and added to the long range scan memory (param = object)

event_player_diplomat_changed.doc: Event for when a faction diplomat to the player has been changed (param = faction, param2 = new faction diplomat, param3 = old faction diplomat)

event_player_discount_added.doc: Event for when a discount for the player is added (object = source object or source faction, param = display name, param2 = discount amount, param3 = end time)

source.doc: Source of discount/commission, can be an object or a faction

event_player_discovered_mission_offer.doc: Event for when a mission offer is discovered by the player and added to the mission offer memory (param = mission offer cue)

event_player_discovered_object.doc: Event for when an object (station module, station, ship, ...) is discovered or scanned by the player and added to the scan memory (param = object, param2 = scan level)

level.doc: Scan level (0 if object was discovered, positive if object was actively scanned)

event_player_ejected.doc: Player was emergency ejected from ship.

event_player_ejecting.doc: Player is emergency ejecting from ship.

event_player_entered_anomaly.doc: Event for the player entering an anomaly (param = entry anomaly, param2 = exit anomaly)

event_player_entered_gate.doc: Event for the player entering a gate (param = entry gate, param2 = exit gate)

event_player_fired_empty_weapon_group.doc: Event for the player attempting to fire a weapon group that has no active weapons in it (param = true if it's a primary, false if it's a secondary weapon group)

primary.doc: Event filter for whether the weapon group being fired was a primary (true) or secondary (false) one

event_player_gravidar_factor_changed.doc: Event for when the player object's gravidar factor has changed (param = new factor, param2 = old factor)

event_player_hacked_object.doc: Event for when an object is hacked by the player (param = hacked, param2 = hacker, param3 = control panel type)

event_player_hiring_discount_added.doc: Event for when a hiring discount for the player is added (object = source object or source faction, param = display name, param2 = discount amount, param3 = end time)

source.doc: Source of discount/commission, can be an object or a faction

event_player_incoming_missile.doc: Event for when a missile is launched at the player (param = target component, param2 = missile, param3 = missile source)

event_player_influence_updated.doc: Event for when the player influence gets updated (param = oldamount, param2 = newamount)

event_player_interaction.doc: Event for when a player responds to an interactive notification (param = interaction param, param2 = secondary interaction param, param3 = ID of cutscene or notification in which the interaction was defined - can be used for <stop_cutscene> or <stop_interactive_notification>, respectively)

event_player_killed_object.doc: Event for when the player kills an object from their currently controlled object (param = killed object, param2 = kill method)

event_player_launched_missile.doc: Event for when the player launches a missile (param = target component, param2 = missile)

event_player_licence_added.doc: Event for when the player is granted a licence for another faction (param = licenceref, use .type or .faction)

event_player_licence_lost.doc: Event for when the player has lost a licence for another faction (param = licenceref, use .type or .faction)

event_player_lost_volatile_wares.doc: Event for when volatile wares in the player's inventory self-destruct (param = table of lost volatile wares with corresponding amounts)

event_player_modding_discount_added.doc: Event for when a modding discount for the player is added (object = source object or source faction, param = display name, param2 = discount amount, param3 = end time)

source.doc: Source of discount/commission, can be an object or a faction

event_player_money_updated.doc: Event for when the player money gets updated (param = oldamount, param2 = newamount)

event_player_opened_crate.doc: Event for when the player opens a crate and claims all its content (param = crate)

event_player_opened_lockbox.doc: Event for when the player opens a lockbox (param = lockbox)

event_player_out_of_ammo.doc: Event for when the player's current weapon runs out of ammo (param = weapon macro, param2 = ranout of ammo due to the shot)

ranout.doc: When true, then we fired and ran out of ammo, otherwise we didn't have ammo in the first place.

event_player_owned_attacked.doc: Event for when a player owned object is attacked (object = attacked object, param = attacker, param2 = kill method, param3 = attacked component)

event_player_owned_attacked_object.doc: Event for when a player owned object, including the player, attacks another object (param = attacker, param2 = attacked object, param3 = kill method)

event_player_owned_claimed_object.doc: Event for when the player faction claims an object (param = claimed object, param2 = pilot (may be null))

event_player_owned_collected_resource.doc: Event for when a player owned object has collected a resource (object = collecting object, param = ware, param2 = amount)

amount.doc: Ware amount

event_player_owned_destroyed.doc: Event for when a player owned object was killed (param = killed object, param2 = killer object, param3 = kill method)

event_player_owned_dropped_objects.doc: Event for when a player owned object drops objects (object = dropping object, param2 = list of dropped objects)

event_player_owned_killed_object.doc: Event for when a player owned object, including player, kills an object (param = killer object, param2 = killed object, param3 = kill method)

event_player_owned_money_updated.doc: Event for when a player-owned object's money gets updated (object = account holder, param = oldamount, param2 = newamount)

event_player_paid_build_plot_changed.doc: Event for when a player-owned station's paid build plot is resized or repositioned (param = station, param2 = old paid build plot size)

station.doc: Station for which build plot changed

event_player_production_cancelled.doc: Event for when a player-owned productionmodule has cancelled its production queue (param = productionmodule, param2 = whether a research project was cancelled, param3 = list of cancelled product wares)

event_player_production_started.doc: Event for when a player-owned productionmodule has started production of a ware (param = productionmodule, param2 = product ware, param3 = whether this is a research project) (see also event_player_production_finished)

event_player_recyclable_processed.doc: Event for when a processing module completes processing a recyclable as result of the player delivering the recyclable object (param = processing module)

event_player_recyclable_processing_start.doc: Event for when a processing module starts processing a recyclable as result of the player delivering the recyclable object (param = processing module)

See <set_relation_boost> and <add_relation_boost>.

event_player_repair_discount_added.doc: Event for when a repair discount for the player is added (object = source object or source faction, param = display name, param2 = discount amount, param3 = end time)

source.doc: Source of discount/commission, can be an object or a faction

event_player_repaired_object.doc: Event is raised when the player has repaired an object (param = destructible that was repaired (can be the object), param2 = object that the destructible was attached to)

event_player_repaired_signal_leak.doc: Event is raised when the player has repaired a signal leak (param = signal leak that was repaired, param2 = object that the signal leak was attached to)

event_player_research_unlocked.doc: Event for when the player has unlocked an item of research (param = research ware)

event_player_ship_hit.doc: Event for when the player controlled ship or ship context is hit by a projectile (param = attacked object, param2 = attacker, param3 = projectile)

event_player_signal_unlock_failed.doc: Event is raised when the player fails to unlock a signal leak (param = signal leak being unlocked)

event_player_signal_unlock_finished.doc: Event is raised when the player has successfully unlock a signal leak (param = signal leak being unlocked, param2 = object that the signal leak was attached to)

event_player_signal_unlock_impossible.doc: Event is raised when the player is not currently able to unlock a signal leak (param = signal leak being unlocked)

event_player_signal_unlock_started.doc: Event is raised when the player begins unlocking a signal leak (param = signal leak being unlocked)

event_player_started_control.doc: Event for when the player starts control (param = controlled object)

event_player_stopped_control.doc: Event for when the player stops control (param = controlled object)

event_player_subordinate_added.doc: Event for when the player adds a new subordinate to squad (param = subordinate, param2 = new assignment)

event_player_subordinate_promoted.doc: Event for when a subordinate of the player's current ship is promoted in place of the old commander (param = old commander, param2 = promoted subordinate)

event_player_subordinate_removed.doc: Event for when the player removes a subordinate from squad (param = subordinate, param2 = old commander)

The event is fired even if the speak fails due to priority being too low or if it is interrupted. In case of a sequence of multiple text entries, page and line match the first provided page/line pair, not the last one.

NOTE: Unlike <event_speak_finished>, this event requires the actor to be specified, and the parameters page and line match the exact spoken text entry after the resolution of text references. WARNING: The event is not fired if the speech cannot start or if it gets interrupted before the end of the line, so it is unreliable. If this event is necessary to wait for a specific line within a multi-line speech, handle those cases by combining with other events in a <check_any> block, e.g. with <event_speak_finished> using the first provided page/line pair (see documentation). Otherwise, this event is not needed and should not be used (use <event_speak_finished> instead).

check.doc: Produce an error message if the provided event object does not exist? Default is true. The event is fired even if the speak fails due to priority being too low or if it is interrupted before the trigger time. generate_loadout.doc: Generate a loadout for a given object

faction.doc: Faction to use for selecting equipment.

flags.doc: Loadout flags for elements to generate (add/remove flags not used in this case).

invertflags.doc: Invert the loadout flags provided in 'flags' attribute.

level.doc: The level of the loadout that should be generated. This should be a value between 0 and 1. If variation is non-zero, it will add variation to this number. Defaults to value defined in parameters.xml.

macro.doc: A macro (ship or station) for which a loadout should be generated. Loadout will be returned as a single entry. Ignored if a sequence is provided.

macros.doc: A list of macros or table of macro amounts, from which the loadout should be generated. Ignored if wares are provided. If neither wares nor macros are provided, default items for faction will be used.

module.doc: A module macro (station module) for which a loadout should be generated. Loadout will be returned as a single entry. Optional, ignored unless macro is provided.

otherfaction.doc: Additional faction to use for selecting equipment, where licences for both selling and buying are required. Ignored if wares or macros are supplied.

remaining.doc: Optional variable to receive remaining items. Contents will follow the format of data supplied, i.e. wares if wares were supplied, macros if macros were supplied. If repeat is false then the remaining items will be the same as the originally-supplied list because quantities are unlimited. Not populated if no ware/macro list is provided at all.

repeat.doc: If a list of wares or macros is supplied, use repeated entries to indicate quantity, otherwise quantity is unlimited. Default is false (unlimited). Ignored if wares or macros are specified as a table, or if neither are specified.

requireblueprints.doc: When generating a default loadout with no supplied ware or macro lists, select only items for which the supplied faction has blueprints. Has no effect for non-player factions. Defaults to false.

result.doc: A list of loadouts that have been generated for the given construction sequence. The index of each loadout refers to the index of the construction plan entry in the sequence.

sequence.doc: A construction sequence for which loadouts should be generated. Loadouts will be generated an entry at a time.

used.doc: Optional variable to receive used items. Contents will follow the format of data supplied, i.e. wares if wares were supplied, macros if macros were supplied, and repeated if repeat parameter is true. Not populated if no ware/macro list is provided at all.

variation.doc: Allows an amount of variation on both the number of slots filled on a given entry in the sequence and what the slots can be filled with. Defaults to value defined in parameters.xml.

wares.doc: A list of wares or table of ware amounts, from which the loadout should be generated. If neither wares nor macros are provided, default items for faction will be used.

generate_shortage_reports.doc: Generate reports of wares which are either in short supply, insufficient or overflowing

includeprocessed.doc: Include processed wares like raw scrap (only relevant for report type 'class.production', optional, defaults to false)

insufficient.doc: Resulting insufficient ware report table (ware is the key and the value is the amount of time this ware has been insufficient)

insufficientthreshold.doc: Threshold factor of cargo level of an insufficient ware to be included in the result. Cargo level is calculated from the current amount in storage vs the target amount e.g. 0.7 means object must hold less than 70% of the target amount of this insufficient ware for it to appear in the result

insufficientthresholdcutoff.doc: Time value that a ware has to be flagged as insufficient for to dismiss the 'insufficientthreshold' filled cargo factor. When time is exceeded the ware will be included in the report regardless of cargo level. If omitted the threshold will always be respected.

log.doc: Enable debug logging of the reports (debug, optional, defaults to false)

overflow.doc: Resulting overflow ware report table (ware is the key and the value is the amount of time this product has been at max capacity)

relevantwares.doc: Ware or list of wares to filter the resulting tables by, removing any other ware.

shortage.doc: Resulting shortage ware report table (ware is the key and the value is the amount of time this ware has been in short supply)

shortagethreshold.doc: Threshold factor of cargo level of an shortage ware to be included in the result. Cargo level is calculated from the current amount in storage vs the target amount e.g. 0.7 means object must hold less than 70% of the target amount of this shortage ware for it to appear in the result

shortagethresholdcutoff.doc: Time value that a ware has to be flagged as in shortage for to dismiss the 'shortagethreshold' filled cargo factor. When time is exceeded the ware will be included in the report regardless of cargo level. If omitted the threshold will always be respected.

move_order.doc: Moves an order to a new position in the order queue (or checks whether moving is possible). Note that this can have side effects for already running orders and can fail in some cases. If the movement changes the first order in the queue that was in the started state (non-critical), the running order will be reset and start over once it reaches the front of the queue. Moving an order fails if: (1) the order is a default order, (2) the newindex value is not a valid index in the order queue, (3) the order is a running order in the critical state or the finish state (except in an order loop), or (4) the movement would replace a running order in the critical state or the finish state (except in an order loop). NOTE: If the order is in an order loop, this action will not affect the currently running order. Moving a running order (at index 1) works, but the order indices will be rotated so that the order remains the current order at index 1. Moving another order to index 1 will actually move it to the last position instead (which is the position right before the current order in the loop). For actually changing the currently running order in a loop, <set_current_loop_order> is required.

register_online_reward_trigger.doc: To be used in personal ventures only. Registers a reward trigger on the online server which will be evaluated on reward calculation once the venture has been completed. This action should be performed before the mission is completed, and not more than once per trigger, otherwise successful registration is not guaranteed.

reinitialise_control_entities.doc: (Re-)Start suitable AI scripts on all control entities of object

release_commandeered_object.doc: Release a commandeered object (job ships restart their orders)

release_job_ship.doc: Release a ship from its job

release_npc_template_from_crew_exchange.doc: Cancel a scheduled crew transfer for this person

reload_envmap_probes.doc: Reloads all envmap probes on the given object. WARNING: This is very expensive! Use with caution and sparingly!

remove_actor_from_room.doc: Remove NPC actor from the room it is in (e.g. landing platform) and clear room and chair slots where set

destroy.doc: Should the actor also be destroyed, as if used in combination with <destroy_object>? Default is false (so the actor may continue to exist even after disconnecting, e.g. as MD cue actor). NOTE: Unlike <destroy_object>, using destroy="true" on this action makes sure that the removal of this actor is not delayed but already happens as part of this action. This may be required by subsequent script actions. Using this attribute should be preferred over the combination of <remove_actor_from_room> with <destroy_object> since it makes sure that the removal and destruction happen in the correct order. NOTE: Even if destroy="false" is used or the attribute is omitted, the actor may still be destroyed implicitly as result of being removed from the universe. In order to be able to work with disconnected actors, they should be associated with an MD cue via the MD action <create_cue_actor> (passing an existing actor if necessary). If the actor gets destroyed either way, it is still highly recommended to use destroy="true" to make the action self-documenting (indicating to the reader that the destruction is desired and expected).

remove_all_cue_actors.doc: Remove all associations of actor NPCs with this cue (the actors will be removed unless referenced outside the MD)

remove_ammo.doc: Removes ammo from a defensible object (see also <add_ammo> and <deplete_ammo>)

remove_build.doc: Remove a build task from an object

remove_buy_amount_override.doc: Remove amount override for buying a ware

remove_commission.doc: Remove price commission for target faction from object/faction, if object and faction are specified, object takes precedence!

remove_cue_actor.doc: Remove association of cue actor with this cue (the actor will be removed unless referenced outside the MD)

timeline.doc: Timeline entry id or a list of timeline entry ids (overrides audiolog attribute, one of the two must exist)

remove_discount.doc: Remove price discount for target faction from object/faction, if object and faction are specified, object takes precedence!

remove_docking_request.doc: Remove assigned dock or docking request for ship (the latter only works if the container is specified)

remove_dynamic_interior.doc: Remove a dynamic interior from an object

remove_encyclopedia_entry.doc: Remove an entry from the encyclopedia (blueprints and spaces are not supported)

type.doc: Encyclopedia entry type (must be used together with item attribute, cannot be used together with value attribute)

remove_from_construction_sequence.doc: Remove entries from the construction sequence that use the provided macros, also detaching all descendant entries in the connection tree. It is possible that more entries get removed than requested in the macro list.

connectors.doc: List of macros of connector modules which may be removed in addition to the functional modules, except for the ones that are still required to keep the remaining sequence connected. It is not necessary to have duplicates in the list.

For all sequence entries for which no cost is defined, a cost of 1.0 will be assumed for functional modules, and 0.0 for connectors. If object is provided, a cost of 0.0 will be assumed for all functional modules that do not exist in the object (i.e. have not been built yet).

macros.doc: List of macros of functional modules to be removed from the construction sequence. In order to remove multiple entries of the same macro, provide the macro multiple times.

object.doc: Object that the construction sequence belongs to (if supplied, it affects attribute 'costs' and result attribute 'removed')

sequence.doc: Existing construction sequence from which entries should be removed

remove_from_group.doc: Remove an object from a group. A valid object must be provided, but it is not an error if the provided object is not a member of the group.

remove_from_list.doc: Remove one or all elements from a list that match the specified value or are in the specified range. It is not an error if no matching list element can be found. Note that the list to be updated is provided in the name attribute, not the list attribute. The list attribute can be used for matching values. (In order to remove a single element at a known list index, e.g. when reverse-iterating over the list, <remove_value> should be used instead.)

reserve_space.doc: Reserve a bounding box that can be respected by other get_safe_pos actions. Has to be cancelled again via cancel_space_reservation. Space has to be either a zone, a sector or a component that has a zone in its context. If no x, y and z extents are specified, scale of the reserved bounding box is mapped to the radius passed into the action. translation formula = (radius / reserving component safe perimeter radius). Example: radius="reservingcomponent.safesize / 2" will lead to a reserved bounding box exactly matching the collidable bounding box of the reserving component. If no radius was specified, the reserved bounding box will be the collidable bounding box by default.

radius.doc: If no x, y and z extents are specified, scale of the reserved bounding box is mapped to the radius passed into the parent get_safe_pos action. translation formula = (get_safe_pos radius / reserving component perimeter radius). Example: radius="reservingcomponent.size / 2" will lead to a reserved bounding box exactly matching the collidable bounding box of the reserving component. If no radius was specified, the reserved bounding box will be the collidable bounding box by default.

space.doc: Component to which the provided position and rotation will have to be relative to. Can only be a zone, a sector, or an object that has a zone in its context, otherwise the reservation will fail.

set_cover_owner.doc: Sets the cover owner faction of an object (cover owner is cleared if faction is null or not supplied)

set_current_loop_order.doc: Sets an order in an order loop as the currently executed order. This will rotate the order indices in the loop so that this order appears at index 1. To set a non-loop order as the current order, use <move_order> instead with newindex="1". The <move_order>action may also be necessary for a loop order before performing <set_current_loop_order>, so that, when the new current order is completed, the loop will resume at the same position as before. Setting the current loop order can fail if: (1) the order is a default order or not in an order loop, (2) the order loop has not started yet, i.e. the currently running order is not part of the order loop, or (3) the currently running loop order is in the critical state or the finish state.

check.doc: Check if setting the current loop order is possible, but do not actually set it (defaults to false)

result.doc: Name of the value that will indicate whether the operation was successful

set_detector_disabled.doc: Set the detector to be disabled or not

disabled.doc: Is the detector disabled? (default is true)

set_emergency_eject_active.doc: Set the player emergency eject feature to active/inactive.

Amount min budget is set to

set_order_syncpoint_reached.doc: Mark the sync point of a running AI order as reached. This action is a requirement for all infinite orders. Once the sync point of such an order is reached, the sync point is ready to be released by a signal, which will terminate the order (<event_object_order_syncpoint_released>). For player orders, the signal behaviour can be controlled in the UI. On queued infinite orders that do not use the sync point signalling system, the sync point is released (the order ends) as soon as the next order is ready in the queue. On default orders, this action only affects the UI display. There is no effect on finite orders.

set_space_faction_logic_allowed.doc: Set whether faction logic is allowed to act in the specified space. When explicitly allowed or disallowed, this setting supersedes the permission of the parent spaces. Use reset_space_faction_logic_allowed to return to the default.

space.doc: Containing space (zone, sector, cluster, or galaxy)

set_space_god_allowed.doc: Set whether the god-system is allowed to act in the specified space. When explicitly allowed or disallowed, this setting supersedes the permission of the parent spaces. Use reset_space_god_allowed to return to the default.

space.doc: Containing space (zone, sector, cluster, or galaxy)

set_space_job_exclusivity.doc: Set whether a space is exclusive for job ships of its own extension. Affects potential spawn location and jobmainsector/zone selection. The space is considered as exclusive for extension jobs if the exclusivity flag is set on the space itself or any parent space (sector, cluster, galaxy).

space.doc: Containing space (zone, sector, cluster, or galaxy)

set_space_jobs_allowed.doc: Set whether the job-system is allowed to use the specified space, primarily affecting ship operating space. When explicitly allowed or disallowed, this setting supersedes the permission of the parent spaces. Use reset_space_job_allowed to return to the default.

space.doc: Containing space (zone, sector, cluster, or galaxy)

set_space_security.doc: Set the security value of the specified space. When explicitly set, this value supersedes the values of the parent spaces. Use reset_space_security to return to the default.

space.doc: Containing space (zone, sector, cluster, or galaxy)

set_space_sunlight.doc: Set the sunlight value of the specified space. When explicitly set, this value supersedes the values of the parent spaces. Use reset_space_sunlight to return to the default.

space.doc: Containing space (zone, sector, cluster, or galaxy)

set_spacesuit_oxygen.doc: Set the oxygen level (in % of maximum oxygen supply) for specified spacesuit

set_stock_reference.doc: Set the stock entry the given entity should use. This expresses the wares the entity is interested in for trading, but does not add those wares to be 'in stock' (see <add_stock>).

vDoc.8.00: Set the stock entry the given entity should use

entity.doc: The entity that gets the stock reference.

set_subordinate_group_assignment.doc: Set the assignment of a commander's subordinate group.

assignment.doc: Assignment to set to specified subordinate group.

commander.doc: Commander of the subordinate group (null not allowed)

subordinategroupid.doc: Subordinate group ID whose assignment will be changed. Integer from 1 to 10.

set_subordinate_group_protected_position.doc: Set the protected position of a commander's subordinate group if assigned to defend a position.

subordinategroupid.doc: Subordinate group ID whose assignment will be changed. Integer from 1 to 10.

set_subordinate_group_protected_sector.doc: Set the protected sector of a commander's subordinate group if assigned to defend a position.

sector.doc: Sector in which subordinate group will operate.

subordinategroupid.doc: Subordinate group ID whose assignment will be changed. Integer from 1 to 10.

set_terraforming_mission_activated.doc: Tells the cluster that a terraforming mission for it has been activated.

set_terraforming_mission_completed.doc: Tells the cluster that its terraforming mission has been completed.

set_terraforming_mission_deactivated.doc: Tells the cluster that its terraforming mission has been deactivated.

set_terraforming_project_data.doc: Changes the properties of a previously added terraforming project.

description.doc: The description of this project that is shown to the player (text reference).

duration.doc: The time between all resources being delivered and the project completing.

name.doc: The name of this project that is shown to the player (text reference).

price.doc: The price of this project in Credits. Is used to calculate the full ware amounts, using the maximum possible prices, if a ware list is supplied.

pricescale.doc: The price scaling method. Defaults to 'absolute'.

repeat.doc: The minimum time between a project completing successfully and it becoming available again. The project is not repeatable if this is not set.

starttime.doc: The time this project was started. If supplied, the effects are already assumed to have taken effect. Defaults to "never".

successchance.doc: The success chance of this project in percent. Defaults to 100.

set_terraforming_stat.doc: Sets a terraforming stat to the given value.

value.doc: The value to set the stat to.

set_timewarp_factor.doc: Set time warp factor (game time that passes during a real-time second, 1.0s if not in time warp)

factor.doc: Time warp factor (value will be limited to between 0.1 and 6.0, resets to default value if not supplied)

set_to_default_flight_control_model.doc: Resets the unit to use the default flight control model. If the object is flying in mass traffic, the default FCM will be "masstraffic". If the object is visible, not docked and in a highway, the default FCM will be "highway". If the object is visible, the previous movement operation for the object set the forcesteering-flag to true and the path of the object has not been aborted, the default FCM will be "steering". If the object is visible and any of the other conditions above are not met, the default will be "spline". If the object is not visible, the default FCM will be "linear".

clearforcedsteering.doc: Whether this object should clear the forcedsteering-flag that might have been set by a previous movement operation. Defaults to false.

set_tolerance_boost.doc: Set tolerance boost (otherobject or faction attribute required)

set_trade_restrictions.doc: Set trade restrictions for an object and/or faction

build.doc: Restriction to only build ships for own faction (default behaviour: inherit from owner / unrestricted)

buy.doc: Restriction to only buy from own faction (default behaviour: inherit from owner / unrestricted)

faction.doc: Faction for which the restrictions will be set. (faction and/or object must be provided)

object.doc: Object for which the restrictions will be set. (object and/or faction must be provided)

restricted.doc: (DEPRECATED) Restriction to only trade with own faction. Overrides buy, sell, supply and build settings. (default: freeforall)

sell.doc: Restriction to only sell to own faction (default behaviour: inherit from owner / unrestricted)

supply.doc: Restriction to only accept supplies from own faction (default behaviour: inherit from owner / unrestricted)

transmute.doc: Restriction to only transmute resources when building ships for own faction (default behaviour: inherit from owner / unrestricted)

set_tradeoffers_enabled.doc: Set trade offers to enabled/disabled for the object. Note: Setting enabled to false will cancel any active/planned trade orders for other parties buying/selling at the object but will not affect trade orders of the object itself!

enabled.doc: Set the enabled state for trade offers of the object. (defaults to true)

object.doc: Object for which the trade offers will be enabled/disabled.

set_trigger_activation_wares.doc: Set platform triggers with optional matching group or tags in the room to require certain inventory wares for activation

amount.doc: The required inventory ware amount (default is 1)

consumeonuse.doc: Are the wares consumed on use? If true, there is also an event when the trigger was "unlocked" by the player. (default is false)

group.doc: Group tag

tags.doc: Specification tag or list of tags

set_triggers_locked.doc: Set triggers on platforms (e.g. doors and buttons) with optional matching group or tags in the room to be locked or not. Note: Internally this increments/decrements a counter, and only when the counter is 0, the trigger is unlocked! (e.g. when locking twice, means you also need to unlock twice!)

duration.doc: How long this lock should last. Unlimited duration if omitted. (optional)

group.doc: Group tag

locked.doc: Are the triggers locked? (default is true)

set_turret_targets.doc: Set turret targets Note: this action will not process targets in low attention, but it will set applicable turrets to deployed status

clearpreferred.doc: If preferredtarget is not provided, clear the existing preferred target (defaults to true)

preferredtarget.doc: Priority target for each turret. If it can't attack, it will choose from the target list

stopshootingold.doc: Stop shooting old targets which are not provided in the new target list (defaults to true)

target.doc: List of target objects for turrets (ignored in low attention)

weaponmode.doc: Turrets in the specified mode will choose from these targets (defaults to any)

set_turrets_armed.doc: Set the turret armed status for all turrets of an object to true or false

value.doc: The value to set the userdata value to.

set_value.doc: Set a variable, userdata, a list element or a table entry to an exact or random value. The operation attribute affects how the value is applied.

name.doc: Name of the value that will receive the result

set_visitor_as_mission_object.doc: Set a visiting object to be related to a MD mission offer or accepted mission

force.doc: Force the visiting object to be related to the provided mission cue, even if it already is related to another mission (defaults to false)

result.doc: Was the object successfully flagged as a mission relevant visitor?

set_weapon_ammo.doc: Set the current ammo (missile type) for one or more weapons (missile launcher and/or missile turrets).

group.doc: Group of weapons to set ammo for (should not be set if object attribute is supplied)

grouptag.doc: Set ammo only for weapons in this connection group (with object attribute only, missile turrets only, all connection group if omitted)

macro.doc: Set ammo only for weapons of this macro type (with object attribute only, all weapons if omitted)

object.doc: Object (defensible or module) for which weapon ammo should be set (should not be set if weapon and/or group attributes are supplied)

primary.doc: Set ammo only for weapons primary/secondary weapon group (with object attribute only, missile launchers on defensibles only, ignored if weapongroup attribute is not supplied, default is primary)

weapon.doc: Specific individual weapon to set ammo for (should not be set if object attribute is supplied)

weapongroup.doc: Set ammo only for weapons in this weapon group (with object attribute only, missile launchers on defensibles only, all weapon groups if omitted, used in conjuction with primary attribute)

weaponmode.doc: Set ammo only for weapons set to this weapon mode (with object attribute only, all weapons if omitted)

set_weapon_mode.doc: Set the weapon mode of a weapon or group of weapons. When weaponmode is omitted, it is reset to default.

group.doc: Group of objects

weaponmode.doc: Weapon mode, or null to reset to default

set_world_atmosphere.doc: Sets a planet's atmosphere text in the encyclopedia.

line.doc: Line ID in a text page

partname.doc: The template part name of the world

set_world_geology.doc: Sets a planet's geology text in the encyclopedia.

line.doc: Line ID in a text page

partname.doc: The template part name of the world

set_world_name.doc: Sets a planet's name text in the encyclopedia.

line.doc: Line ID in a text page

partname.doc: The template part name of the world

set_world_population.doc: Sets a planet's population text and amount in the encyclopedia. If you just want to display the number use page 1042 and line 10021.

amount.doc: The new population amount. Only shown if the population text contains the '$POPULATION$' placeholder. If omitted the number is not changed.

line.doc: Line ID in a text page

partname.doc: The template part name of the world

set_world_settlements.doc: Sets a planet's settlements text in the encyclopedia.

line.doc: Line ID in a text page

partname.doc: The template part name of the world

set_wreck_persistence.doc: Set this wrecks persistance in the game (setting to false restores the default despawn time)

persistent.doc: Should object be persistent? (default is true)

share_object_account.doc: Tells this object to use the account of otherobject. Optionally can transfer the money in the account to the object supplied as transferto (may be the same as otherobject). If otherobject and transferto are invalid / omitted this behaves like <remove_object_account>

vDoc.8.00: Tells this object to use the account of otherobject. Optionally can transfer the money in the account to the object supplied as transferto (may be the same as otherobject). If otherobject and transferto are invalid / omitted this behaves like <remove_object_account />

otherobject.doc: (optional) The object whose account to share, will default to faction account of transferto object if omitted!

transferto.doc: (optional) The object to which any money in the actors account should be transferred. (money will be lost if omitted)

shoot.doc: Start shooting a weapon without a target (requires object on visible attention level and a suitable weapon selection)

missiles.doc: Select between lasers and missile launchers. False for lasers, true for missile launchers. Defaults to false.

primary.doc: Shoot weapons in active primary weapon group. Defaults to true.

secondary.doc: Shoot weapons in active secondary weapon group. Defaults to true.

turrets.doc: Shoot using turrets instead of main weapons. Missiles attribute is respected, primary or secondary have no effect. Defaults to false.

weaponmode.doc: Only weapons/turrets set to the specified mode will shoot at the target, defaults to any.

shoot_at.doc: Shoot at target when the opportunity arises

additional_targets.doc: Optional list of additional targets that may be fired upon if opportunity arises (not supported together with largetarget=true). The object specified by the target attribute must not be in this list (will be ignored and an error will be logged otherwise)

fixedtarget.doc: Prevent target from being overridden? Default is false

largetarget.doc: Is the target a very large object, e.g. a station? Default is false (does not support additonal targets)

missiles.doc: Select between lasers and missile launchers. False for lasers, true for missile launchers. Defaults to false.

primary.doc: Shoot weapons in active primary weapon group. Defaults to true.

secondary.doc: Shoot weapons in active secondary weapon group. Defaults to true.

tolerance.doc: Tolerance angle (optional). A positive angle value overrides the default tolerance angle defined in the weapons set to shoot. A non-positive value has no effect.

weaponmode.doc: Only weapons/turrets set to the specified mode will shoot at the target(s), defaults to any.

show_help.doc: Show text from help text page if it was not shown before (when using line attribute), or show custom text (when using custom attribute)

custom.doc: Custom help text, takes precedence over line attribute

force.doc: Always show help text? If true, the help is shown even if the help text ID was already used before (ignored when using custom attribute)

line.doc: Line (text ID) on help text page. Text will be shown if not shown before, or if force attribute value is true

show_help_multi.doc: Show multiple texts from help text page if it was not shown before, or if force attribute value is true

allowclose.doc: Whether the player is allowed to close the hint, use with care (default is false)

allowinmenu.doc: Whitelist this help text in menus which normally forbid them (e.g. the options menu) - format 'MenuA MenuB MenuC'

force.doc: Always show help text? If true, the help is shown even if the help text ID was already used before. Default is false.

halign.doc: Horizontal alignment of the hint text (default is 'left')

log.doc: Add help text to logbook? Overrides individual line settings. Default is false

position.doc: Position of help text (defined in parameters.xml) - defaults to 0

silent.doc: Suppress sound effect? Default is false

width.doc: Factor to modify help text width in percent (default is 200, minimum is 50)

highlightonly.doc: Only highlight the element (default is false)

id.doc: The ID of the help overlay.

show_input_help.doc: Show help text for input function (e.g. INPUT_ACTION_QUICKSAVE or INPUT_STATE_ROLL_LEFT). Keyboard/controller use is detected automatically.

name.doc: Input function name (see inputmap.xml)

show_interactive_notification.doc: Show an interactive notification in the target monitor

faction.doc: The faction for which the notoriety ladder should be displayed (optional)

object.doc: The object for which the notoriety ladder should be displayed (optional). Takes precedence if both faction and object are supplied.

priority.doc: The priority, an integer between 0 and 9 (default is 1). Unqueued notifications can only be aborted and replaced by unqueued notifications of same or higher priority, or by cutscenes. The queue for queued notifications is also sorted by priority. NOTE: Non-silent interactive events (notifications and cutscenes with flashing target monitor) are generally treated as having a higher priority than any non-interactive events.

relationeffect.doc: True iff a relation effect (blinking effect in faction bar) should be shown

vDoc.8.00: true iff a relation effect (blinking effect in faction bar) should be shown

result.doc: (optional) ID of resulting notification object

sound.doc: Sound ID (either a plain name string or a script expression that evaluates to a string - default is "notification_generic" if omitted or empty)

text.doc: Notification text to be displayed, either a single string with possible line breaks (left-aligned), or a list of strings. In a list, each pair of strings defines a single row (left-aligned and right-aligned text). In the list you can use [ string, r, g, b ] instead of a simple string to specify an RGB text color, with color values between 0 and 255. The default color is determined by the notification priority (a priority above 1 will turn the color red). Numbers are also accepted instead of strings. The maximum number of rows is 4 in the message ticker (<show_notification>), and 7 in the target monitor (<show_interactive_notification>)

timeout.doc: Maximal duration of notification. If not supplied, the notification will end after a default timeout (currently 5s).

show_notification.doc: Show a non-interactive notification in the message ticker

priority.doc: The priority, an integer between 0 and 9 (default is 1). Unqueued notifications can only be aborted and replaced by unqueued notifications of same or higher priority, or by cutscenes. The queue for queued notifications is also sorted by priority. NOTE: Non-silent interactive events (notifications and cutscenes with flashing target monitor) are generally treated as having a higher priority than any non-interactive events.

sound.doc: Sound ID (either a plain name string or a script expression that evaluates to a string - default is "notification_generic" if omitted or empty)

text.doc: Notification text to be displayed, either a single string with possible line breaks (left-aligned), or a list of strings. In a list, each pair of strings defines a single row (left-aligned and right-aligned text). In the list you can use [ string, r, g, b ] instead of a simple string to specify an RGB text color, with color values between 0 and 255. fromright.doc: Defines whether reloffsetx is defined from the right or left border - default is false

fromtop.doc: Defines whether reloffsety is defined from the top or bottom border - default is false

reloffsetx.doc: Defines how much relative offset the overlay has from the left border - defaults to 0.1

reloffsety.doc: Defines how much relative offset the overlay has from the bottom border - defaults to 0.1

relwidth.doc: Defines how much relative screen space the overlay uses - defaults to 0.8

shuffle_group.doc: Shuffle components in a group randomly

group.doc: Group of objects

shuffle_list.doc: Shuffle elements of a list randomly

signal_cue.doc: Send a signal to a cue, triggering cues that wait for this signal via <event_cue_signalled>. The signal will be dispatched in the same frame, but only after the current cue actions are completed. NOTE: Make sure that the signal does not activate the current cue again (directly or indirectly), which could lead to an infinite loop.

check.doc: Check for existing cue listeners? If true and there are no listeners for the cue signal, a warning is produced. Default is true.

signal_cue_instantly.doc: Signal a cue instantly, triggering cues that wait for this signal via <event_cue_signalled>. Can pass parameter to <event_cue_signalled>. NOTE: Make sure that the signal does not activate the current cue again (directly or indirectly), which could lead to an infinite recursion.

check.doc: Check for existing cue listeners? If true and there are no listeners for the cue signal, a warning is produced. Default is true.

signal_objects.doc: Signal an object and/or a group of objects using param and param2, each object will receive this signal as if it were an event. NOTE: When used in MD without a delay, make sure that the signal does not activate the current cue again (directly or indirectly), which could lead to an infinite recursion.

delay.doc: (optional) delay this signal by the specified amount of time

sort_collectables_by_value.doc: Sort a list of collectables by price value. Note: Sorting collectables with identical price values will retain their relative order from the input list. Consider shuffling the collectables list first.

name.doc: Result list of sorted collectables

object.doc: Collecting object, used to filter out collectables which can't be stored

sort_group.doc: Sort components in a group by a provided criterion

group.doc: Group of objects

silent.doc: Suppress error if group contains components that cannot be sorted, e.g. disconnected or unreachable objects? NOTE: If the group to be sorted is a result of a find-action or count-condition, consider sorting there already instead (using the corresponding sort attribute), with the effect that unreachable objects are excluded from the search result.

vDoc.8.00: Suppress error if group contains components that cannot be sorted, e.g. disconnected or unreachable objects? Such members remain in the group but will be placed at the end.

sortbydistanceto.doc: Sort group members by distance to provided object (only one sortby* attribute can be used; see also sortdescending)

sortbygatedistancefrom.doc: Sort group members by number of gate jumps from provided object (only one sortby* attribute can be used; see also sortdescending). If there are members without a valid gate distance (i.e. objects to which there is no path through the galaxy from the provided object), they remain in the group but will be placed at the end. This case will also trigger an error message, unless suppressed with the silent attribute.

sortbygatedistanceto.doc: Sort matching objects by number of gate jumps to provided object (only one sortby* attribute can be used; see also sortdescending). If there are members without a valid gate distance (i.e. objects from which there is no path through the galaxy to the provided object), they remain in the group but will be placed at the end. This case will also trigger an error message, unless suppressed with the silent attribute.

sortbyvalue.doc: Sort matching objects by a numeric value per object, provided by this script expression, which is evaluated for each object and can access the current object via 'loop.element' (only one sortby* attribute can be used; see also sortdescending)

sortdescending.doc: Should the objects be sorted in descending order? In this case the first object will have the highest associated value (e.g. largest distance when sorting by distance). This has no effect if no sort criteria are defined.

sort_list.doc: Sort elements in a list either by their values or by a provided criterion

sortbydistanceto.doc: Reference object for checking distance (slot or offset are not supported). If all list elements are objects, sort all objects by distance to provided object (only one sortby* attribute can be used). Objects that are not in the galaxy are treated as having a distance that is larger than any valid distance.

sortbygatedistancefrom.doc: Reference object for checking jump distance. If all list elements are objects, sort all objects by number of gate jumps from provided object (only one sortby* attribute can be used). Objects with an invalid gate distance (i.e. objects to which there is no path through the galaxy from the provided object) are treated as having a distance that is larger than any valid distance.

sortbygatedistanceto.doc: Reference object for checking jump distance. If all list elements are objects, sort all objects by number of gate jumps to provided object (only one sortby* attribute can be used). Objects with an invalid gate distance (i.e. objects to which there is no path through the galaxy from the provided object) are treated as having a distance that is larger than any valid distance.

sortbyvalue.doc: Sort values by a sort criterion provided by this script expression, which is evaluated for each element and can access the current value and index via 'loop.element' and 'loop.index', respectively (only one sortby* attribute can be used)

vDoc.8.00: Optionally sort values by a sort criterion provided by this script expression, which is evaluated for each element and can access the current value and index via 'loop.element' and 'loop.index', respectively

sortdescending.doc: Should the values be sorted in descending order (from highest to lowest)?

sort_people.doc: Sort people list. Note: Sorting people with identical sort values will retain their relative order from the input list. Consider shuffling the templatelist first.

name.doc: Name of the value that will receive the result

post.doc: Post to sort for potential skill by (required for sorter="potentialskillforpost", ignored otherwise)

role.doc: Role to sort for potential skill by (required for sorter="potentialskillforrole", ignored otherwise)

skill.doc: Skill to sort by (required for sorter="skill", ignored otherwise)

sort_trades.doc: Sort trade list. Note: Sorting trades with identical sort values will retain their relative order from the input list. Consider shuffling the trade list first.

refobject.doc: Reference object to sort trades by distances or offeramounts (required for sorter="distance", optional for sorter="offeramount" or sorter="offervolume")

spawn_docked.doc: Attempt to spawn an existing ship in a dock (bypassing dock request checks)

spawn_drop.doc: Spawn the drop defined for the object

drop.doc: Drop string identifier (will drop whatever is currently defined in the object if not supplied)

spawn_waiting_job_ship.doc: Spawn a waiting job ship into an area of space or a dock

dock.doc: Either a DockingBay, Container or Module component or a Dockslot to spawn in (takes precedence from zone or sector)

result.doc: Was the ship successfully spawned?

sector.doc: Sector to spawn the ship in using position in the sector space. Creates a tempzone if a zone does not exist at the coordinates

zone.doc: Zone to spawn in (used if dock is omitted or invalid, take precedence from sector)

backgroundcomm.doc: Is this a background speech and is the player able to hear this over comm? Note that a speech in background and a speech over comm are two separate properties, and this flag primarily indicates a preference, which can be partially or fully ignored. This flag also allows exceeding the maximum background comm distance as specified in parameters.xml. - If the player is the speaker or this is a broadcast, the speech is always in foreground. - If a recipient is specified, the speech is in background depending on whether the recipient is an NPC or the player. - If the speech is in background and the recipient is in hearing range of the speaker, the speech will be over comm only if backgroundcomm is enabled and the player is not within hearing range. (Otherwise it is assumed that the player is required to be close to the speaker to hear the speech.)

broadcast.doc: Is this a broadcast speech of an entity to a group of people over comm? This implies background speech, but may cause a different comm filter to be applied. Default is false.

caninterrupt.doc: Allow interrupting a speech of the same priority? Default is true.

check.doc: Check for errors resolving an object name or description? Default is true

priority.doc: Speech priority. Speeches of lower priority will be interrupted. Default is 0. The priority is capped at 99, since 100 or higher is reserved for conversations.

recipient.doc: Speech recipient, i.e. the character being spoken to (optional). Pass an NPC if this is a background speech between two NPCs, which affects the voice style of the speech. Default is the player (if omitted or null).

topic.doc: Speech topic, i.e. the character being spoken about (optional). Pass an NPC or the player if the person being spoken about may have a grammatical effect on the sentence.

voiceover.doc: Is this a voiceover speech in a cinematic scene? The entity will speak with maximal volume even if not near the player. Default is false.

behavior.doc: Animation sequence behavior (if omitted, uses roomslot tags to decide behaviour)

blend.doc: Allow blending to the next sequence from the current animation (default is true)

immediate.doc: Perform an immediate transition to the next sequence (default is false)

result.doc: Name of the value that will receive the result

transition.doc: Perform a transition to the next sequence (defaults to false)

speed.doc: Speed of the character in m/s

triggeranimation.doc: Trigger the default animations for the destination room slot on the actor when they arrive (defaults to true)
