stop_actor_walk.doc: Stop the actor's current walk behaviour

stop_attack.doc: Notify the game that a target is no longer being attacked by this entity

stop_cutscene.doc: Stop a running cutscene, or cancel a queued targetmonitor cutscene before it is started

stop_firing_at_target.doc: Stop firing at a specific target

weaponmode.doc: Turret in the specified mode will stop shooting at the target(s), defaults to any.

stop_interactive_notification.doc: Stop an interactive notification in the target monitor, or cancel a queued notification before it is started (NOTE: For interactive cutscenes, use <stop_cutscene> instead)

id.doc: Identifier of an interactive notification as returned by <show_interactive_notification>

stop_long_range_scan.doc: Stops a long range scan for the object

stop_mass_traffic_quota.doc: Make a mass traffic quota stop

endtime.doc: The time the quota should end at the earliest (defaults to now if not supplied)

stop_music.doc: Stop a manually started music track

stop_observation.doc: Notify the game that a target is no longer being observed by this entity

speak.doc: Whether Betty should say that autopilot has been disengaged (defaults to true)

stop_script_influences.doc: Stop any influences from influencelists that were applied to 'object' using <apply_influencelist> with the 'allowstop' flag set to true

object.doc: Object to stop script-added influences for

missiles.doc: Select between lasers and missile launchers. False for lasers to stop shooting, true for missile launchers to stop shooting. Defaults to false.

primary.doc: Stop shooting weapons in active primary weapon group. Defaults to true.

secondary.doc: Stop shooting weapons in active secondary weapon group. Defaults to true.

turrets.doc: Stop shooting turrets instead of main weapons. Missiles attribute is respected, primary or secondary have no effect. Defaults to false.

weaponmode.doc: Only weapons/turrets set to the specified mode will stop shooting, defaults to any.

stop_towing_object.doc: Makes a ship stop towing an object (removes connection, disarms ship's tug weapons and resets the towed object's movement controller; no effect if nothing is being towed)

store_trade_offer_snapshot.doc: Store a snapshot of the current trade offers on the specified object in the player trade memory.

substitute_text.doc: Search in a text for sub-strings and substitutes them

source.doc: Source text. If not supplied, the text attribute is used instead.

text.doc: Name of the value that will receive the result text. If source is not supplied then this value is also used as text source.

subtract_build_resources.doc: Subtract required resources to build an object / perform a build task. Can use transmutable resources.

allowtransmute.doc: Controls whether converting any available transmute resources is allowed to fulfill resource needs not covered by cargo. (optional, defaults to false)

build.doc: Build task to construct a ship. Mutually exclusive with "buildobject" attribute. (either build or buildobject is required)

buildobject.doc: Existing object to be built as a new object. Mutually exclusive with "build" attribute. (either buildobject or build is required)

cargo.doc: A variable holding a script table representing the current resource cargo available on object. (optional) Variable is initialised from the current cargo storage of object if it isn't a valid cargo table already. The table will have the resources required to do the build removed IFF all resource requirements are met (including any transmuted resources if 'allowtransmute' is true).

object.doc: Container object that has a build module

result.doc: Name of the value that will receive the result. Will be true if all resource requirements (including transmutation) for building the given buildobject/buildtask have been met. In any other case it will be false.

teleport_player.doc: Trigger a teleport to a object

control.doc: Have the player take control if it is free (defaults to true)

force.doc: Allow the teleportation, even if the research criteria is not fulfilled (defaults to false)

teleport_player_to_spacesuit.doc: Teleport the player into their spacesuit

allowinhighway.doc: Should the action be performed even if the player will end up in a highway? (default is false)

emergency.doc: Is this an emergency teleport? If true, "launch" property is ignored and spacesuit will be outside of the current object's bounding box (default is false)

instant.doc: Should the teleport effect be skipped? (default is false)

launch.doc: Should the player launch from the XS dock? If false, spacesuit will be at current player position (default is true)

toggle_timewarp.doc: Toggle time warp (SETA). NOTE: Activation requires that SETA is in the player's inventory and the activation conditions are met. For example, SETA is not possible during a conversation.

transfer_marine_to_operation.doc: Transfer a marine from an object to the internals of a boarding operation

object.doc: Object containing the marine to transfer

transfer_marines_from_operation.doc: Transfer a list of marines from a boarding operation to an object

object.doc: Object to transfer the marines to

result.doc: List of people successfully transferred from otherobject to object

transfer_money.doc: Transfers amount from one entity to another, if possible

amount.doc: Amount to be transferred

result.doc: Resulting amount that was actually transferred

transfer_people.doc: Transfer people as defined in a build order, or by this definition

force.doc: Force the transfer, ignoring people capacities. Defaults to false.

providepeople.doc: Is the providing container allowed to provide people from their own people? Takes precidence over 'provideworkforce'. Defaults to true.

provideworkforce.doc: Is the providing container allowed to provide people from their own workforce? (defaults to true)

receivepeople.doc: Is the receiving container allowed to receive the people as person templates? Takes precidence over 'receiveworkforce'. Defaults to true.

receiveworkforce.doc: Is the receiving container allowed to receive the people as workforce? (defaults to false)

result.doc: Result list of people successfully transferred from otherobject to object

name.doc: Name of the value that will receive the result

delay.doc: (optional) delay the animation by the specified amount of time

group.doc: The group ID (which may be a string or a tag) used to find specific parts to trigger the animation on (if neither this nor tags are supplied, the animation is triggered on the entire component; has no effect if tags are also specified)

immediate.doc: Set to true if the new animation should start immediately instead of being queued.

object.doc: The component to trigger the animation on

tags.doc: The tag list to find specific parts to trigger the animation on (if neither this nor a group is supplied, the animation is triggered on the entire component)

trigger_boarding.doc: Trigger a boarding process via an MD cue, including mission guidance for the player

boarder.doc: The marine commander that controls the boarding operation

faction.doc: The boarder faction, which is trying to take ownership of the target (default is the player faction)

target.doc: The target object to be boarded

unassign_diplomacy_ship.doc: Unassign a ship assisting a diplomacy agent. If ship is stored at the player HQ, it will attempt to be retrieved and then change owner to player.

unassign_order_syncpoint_from_order.doc: Unassign an AI-controlled sync point from an AI order. If the AI order is the owner of the sync point, the sync point is removed completely.

uninstall_software.doc: Uninstalls the given software (and all previous versions) from object. If the software to be uninstalled (or any of its previous versions) are part of the default software, these will remain installed!

unlock_achievement.doc: Unlock an achievement (no effect if it was already unlocked)

name.doc: Achievement name

scenario.doc: Can the achievement be unlocked in a scenario gamestart? Default is false

unlock_all_holomap_input.doc: Unlocks all input for the holomap.

unlock_getup.doc: Unlocks getting up from control position.

unlock_holomap_position_input.doc: Unlocks position input for the holomap.

unlock_holomap_rotation_input.doc: Unlocks rotation input for the holomap.

unlock_holomap_zoom_input.doc: Unlocks zoom input for the holomap.

unpause_mission_timer.doc: Unpause the current mission timer if it was previously paused. NOTE: If the current mission *objective* has a timer, it is independent and remains unaffected by pausing or unpausing the mission timer - see <unpause_objective_timer>

unpause_objective_timer.doc: Unpause the current objective timer if it was previously paused.

unpause_spacesuit_oxygen.doc: Resume the consumption of oxygen for the specified spacesuit

update_mission.doc: Update metadata and briefing of an existing mission associated with a cue

duration.doc: Duration of the mission. Only applicable for queued thread sub-missions, otherwise use attribute endtime instead. Cannot be combined with attributes endtime or showelapsedtime. The duration will be converted to an endtime automatically when the queued sub-mission starts (see endtime attribute for details).

endtime.doc: Updated end time of the mission. Set to 0s to remove existing end time. Cannot be combined with attributes duration or showelapsedtime.

showelapsedtime.doc: Should the elapsed time for this mission be displayed in the message ticker? Set to false to remove existing timer display. Cannot be combined with attributes endtime or duration.

update_mission_thread.doc: Update metadata and briefing of an existing mission thread associated with a cue

duration.doc: Duration of the mission (set to 0s to remove existing duration)

update_mission_thread_offer.doc: Update metadata and briefing of an existing mission thread offer associated with a cue

duration.doc: Duration of the mission (set to 0s to remove existing duration)

space.doc: Space location or list of locations the player must be in for the mission to appear in the BBS (unless hidden for another reason)

update_objective_endtime.doc: Update the current objective end time

update_objective_progress.doc: Update progress count of the objective for the cue's mission. The progress data must already have been set up by <set_objective>.

max.doc: Max progress count (rounded to an integer, remains unchanged if not supplied)

progress.doc: Current progress count (rounded to an integer)

silent.doc: Change the objective silently? This suppresses the mission objective bar and the sound effect. Default is false

update_offer.doc: Update metadata and briefing of an existing mission offer associated with a cue

duration.doc: Duration of the mission. Set to 0s to remove existing duration. Cannot be combined with attribute showelapsedtime.

hidden.doc: Is the offer hidden from the BBS? If true, the mission offer can only be found via the offer location.

showelapsedtime.doc: Should the elapsed time for this mission be displayed in the message ticker? Set to false to remove existing timer display. Cannot be combined with attribute duration.

space.doc: Space location or list of locations the player must be in for the mission to appear in the BBS (unless hidden for another reason)

update_signal_leak_voice.doc: Specify voice pageID and a text ID or a list of text IDs for an existing signal leak. A random one will be chosen if multiple are provided. Only valid and required for type signalleaktype.voice!

lines.doc: Line ID or a list of line IDs on a text page (list may include time values within the line ID sequence, to insert delays/pauses between lines)

update_trade.doc: Update certain parameters of a trade

amount.doc: New amount for the trade (optional, should already be adjusted to be the amount we can afford)

desiredamount.doc: New desiredamount for the trade (optional, how much we *really* want, ignoring financial constraints)

price.doc: New price (per unit) for the trade (optional)

resume.doc: Resume this action when an interrupt script returns, instead of resuming at a label? This has no effect if a resume attribute was specified in <run_interrupt_script>. If the action was already completed during the interrupt, the script will continue after the action immediately. Note that changing the resume attribute has no effect on existing savegames. The resume state will be restored as it was saved before, even if the attribute changes in the script.

wait_for_prev_script.doc: Wait for blocking action of previous AI script to complete (blocking). Requires information stored on this object via <save_ai_action_state>. Only a few specific blocking actions are handled here, in other cases no blocking happens.

action.doc: Value that receives the name of the blocking action of the previous script

object.doc: Value that receives the event source object of the blocking action of the previous script

param.doc: Value that receives the first parameter of the blocking action of the previous script (depends on the action). For <execute_custom_trade> this is the buyer.

param2.doc: Value that receives the second parameter of the blocking action of the previous script (depends on the action). For <execute_custom_trade> this is the trade.

sector.doc: Sector to warp the object in using position in the sector space. Creates a tempzone if a zone does not exist at the coordinates

zone.doc: Zone to warp to (take precedence from sector)

write_incoming_message.doc: Write a message that is received by the player

autodelete.doc: Should the message be auto-deleted when the interaction object is destroyed? Default is false. (NOTE: This flag only refers to the interaction object. The autodelete handling for a supplied source object is not adjustable.)

object.doc: Interaction object, depending on the interaction type

position.doc: Interaction position, depending on the interaction type

read.doc: Should the message already be marked as read by the player? Default is false.

result.doc: ID of the incoming message

source.doc: Message source, either a string or an object. If an object is provided, the message will be deleted automatically in case the source object is killed.

write_to_logbook.doc: Write an entry into the logbook

bonus.doc: Optional bonus amount of money associated with the logbook entry (if not supplied, or 0, then will not be shown in the logbook)

entity.doc: Optional source entity for logbook entry (either a real entity, in which case the entity name will be used, or an arbitrary name as text)

faction.doc: Optional source faction logbook entry (either a real faction, in which case the faction name will be used, or an arbitrary name as text)

highlighted.doc: Optional flag specifying whether the logbook entry should be highlighted.

money.doc: Optional amount of money associated with the logbook entry (if not supplied, or 0, then will not be shown in the logbook)

object.doc: Interaction object, depending on the interaction type

position.doc: Interaction position, depending on the interaction type

separator.doc: Separator to be used between left and right texts of a notification row, in case the notification format is used in the text attribute (default is a single space)

text.doc: Logbook entry text, either a single string with possible line breaks, or a list of strings in notification format (see <show_notification>). When using the notification format and both left and right columns of a row contain text, the texts will be concatenated with a single space as separator, if no custom separator is provided in the separator attribute.
